experiments.scope: H1 (unconditional first blocks), H3 (full first-block evaluation on PCV), H4 (full preprocessing and advice replay from scratch), H5 and the Lemma 4.1 identities on real first blocks (proof.md Sections 4, 7, 10, 12, 13). Trials 0..7: first 64 unconditional organizer-seeded first blocks per trial, the W7 passes of all 32 classes counted without selection (expectation 137.0 per trial under H1); then first blocks drawn from the organizer seed (two uniform 256-bit words from SHAKE-256 of the experiment id and seed per first block; real 38-step compressions) until one has a passing class (at most 64); its first passing class is run on two batches (its first 512 members): the counted 2-stage row-16 program of that class is executed instruction by instruction and its ok plane compared lane by lane with E16x computed from the Step-2 words and the 38-step trace; W7 is compared with c7 - A_{-1} and checked in F7. Trial 0 also clears the preprocessing caches and replays from scratch the full charged preprocessing (H4: all 32 classes = 786,432 variants in G and all 96 Stage-1 + 96 Stage-2 row-16 programs = 56,116 + 48,804 = 104,920 instructions, 0 spills), verifies the advice (S and the 160 row-16 words GL of P8), and runs the full first-block program process_fb across all 32 classes on the semi-free-start witness PCV (H3: 6 passing classes, 147,456 evaluated variants, requiring A0S to be found with 0 other row-16 passes in 406,350 operations). Returns M0 || M1 and M0 || M1' of the class's first member (128 bytes each; one variant of one chaining value, not a collision) iff there is no mismatch across all checks. Trials 8..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 8 (every executed trial mismatch-free, including Trial 0's full H3/H4 preprocessing and process_fb replay); full collisions of the target: 0 (a returned pair is not a collision). Observations (untrusted): uncond_first_blocks (64), uncond_class_passes (H1: mean 137.0 per trial; grouped passes give a large variance), first_blocks, passing_classes, lanes (512), stage3a_passes, mismatches (0), and on Trial 0 preproc_variants (786432), preproc_insns (104920), sfs_passing_classes (6), sfs_other_r16_passes (0), sfs_ops (406350). Validation by us: 8 pairs returned per request, 0 mismatches, at most 0.8 s; unconditional: 5,514 class W7 passes in 2,560 first blocks against 5,480 expected.

experiments.scope: Consistency check of the q3 estimator and H3 on organizer-seeded collisions (H2, H3; proof.md Sections 6, 9, 13): it is not an estimate of q3 and not evidence for the bound q3_model, which rests on the participant study. Trials 0..9: 10 independent replicates of the estimator of q3 for the accepted event (row 16 exact over the 160 W16 words; rows 17..22 by proposals with the row's E bits imposed, at row 19 one of the four observed condition patterns drawn uniformly with weight 4 x 2^-f and the row checked on signed differences; tail: a variant of 512 embedded samples of the selected classes, W7 uniform in F7 (its three affine families; the family drawn by rejection from its own word, the value bits from a fresh word), rows 23..37, outputs compared; randomness SHAKE-256 of the experiment id and trial seed). Every success is rebuilt into (CV1, M1, M1') and accepted only if the two 38-step compressions from CV1 are equal, M1 != M1', the pair is in the accepted event and W7 is in F7. Trial t < 10 returns its first verified pair as CV1 || M1 and CV1 || M1' (96 bytes each; semi-free-start collisions, never collisions from the IV); trial 10 also runs the full 32-class online program process_fb on the last verified pair's CV1 (H3 check on a fresh organizer-seeded collision) and returns that pair iff no rebuild failed, the mean of the 10 estimates is at least 2^-98.6000, and process_fb re-finds the pair's variant a0 in its class; trials 11..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: one semi-free-start pair per replicate with a tail success (development requests: 4 to 10 of 10 replicates; validation by us: 7 to 9) and 1 from trial 10 (a pass; trial 10 needs trials 0..9 in the same request); full collisions of the target: 0. The pass rule was fixed from 48 development requests (pooled means: min -98.100, median -96.398) before any validation run; a pass checks a reduced replica, it is not an estimate of q3. Observations (untrusted): log2_estimate (-1000 for no success), accepted_pairs, failed_rebuilds (0); trial 10 log2_pooled_mean, h3_passing_classes, h3_other_accepted (0). What a pass shows: the replica estimates the same event as the study, restricted to the four row-19 patterns (a lower bound) and to 512 of the selected variants, and the full 32-class online program re-finds the organizer-seeded collision on its CV1 with 0 other accepted pairs; its 48 development requests (480 replicates) have mean 2^-96.2059 against the study mean 2^-96.1821. Shifting their pooled means down by 1, 2 or 3 bits (a q3 that much lower) makes 2%, 38% and 90% of requests fail the rule (none at the claimed level): a pass excludes a gross error in the estimator or the program, it does not certify the bound.
